# Deploy_Tienkung WALKAMP reference snapshot

These two files are unmodified reference snapshots from `Open-X-Humanoid/Deploy_Tienkung`, branch `3.0`, commit `9786cf1a7ed9e3bead1a8de47ed6a5c251cb1869`:

- `fsm_walkamp.py`
- `walk_amp.yaml`

They are provided for source comparison only. The standalone demo uses `tienkung_demo.walkamp.WalkAmpPolicy` and does not import the upstream ROS/FSM implementation.

The upstream BSD 3-Clause license is copied to `assets/official_evt2/DEPLOY_TIENKUNG_LICENSE.txt`.
